semantic.justification: Original ICU78.3 calendar.cpp type table and locale calendar selection, including legacy canonicalization, calendar keyword and supplemental territory preferences. This is selection only, not a replacement Calendar factory. Unconsumed APIs, native ABI/mutex/allocator and undefined-input behavior, complete UNO/display formatting, formatter/column auto-input and final CSV integration remain outside the evidence for this module. No alternate calendar selection or unsupported-known-type error is introduced. Full unchanged calendar.cpp source selector matches1580 cases including1502 locale names over complete pinned resources.
